sources.snippet: Llama[a] (" Large Language Model Meta AI " serving as a backronym) was a family of large language models (LLMs) released by Meta AI starting in February 2023. [3] Llama models come in different sizes, ranging from 1 billion to 2 trillion parameters. sources.title: [2407.21783] The Llama 3 Herd of Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems are powered by foundation models. This paper presents a new set of foundation models, called Llama 3. It is a herd of language models that natively support multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage.
